title: GUIYI Task Schema V2.0
description: Machine-readable Task contract for the GUIYI Quant workstation. YAML frontmatter + Markdown body.

kind.description: Entity kind — must be 'Task' for this schema

epic_id.description: Parent epic identifier, if this task belongs to an epic

approval_scope.description: Explicit approval scope, independent of status

depends_on.description: Task IDs that must be CLOSED or SKIPPED before this task can start

allowed_paths.description: File/directory globs that this task is permitted to modify

forbidden_paths.description: File/directory globs that this task MUST NOT touch

resource_locks.description: Named resource locks required before execution. Scopes: data-writer, postgres-metadata-writer, rqdata-download, main-contract-map-writer, runtime-jm, after-market-archive, external-notification, docs-delete

required_tests.description: Shell commands that must pass (exit 0) before this task can progress

base_branch.description: Base branch for this task (defaults to main). Used to verify the merge-base for scope reports.

base_commit.description: Optional required workstation baseline commit. If present, Issue-first bootstrap must verify it is an ancestor of the task branch HEAD.

model_profile.description: Abstract model capability profile — never hardcode a specific model name

critical.description: Marks strategy/backtest/database tasks requiring extra caution

production_write_approved.description: Whether production write operations have been explicitly approved

production_write_requested.description: Whether this task explicitly requests production writes

github_pr.description: Linked GitHub Draft PR / PR in #N format; may be empty before PR creation.

branch.description: Git branch for this task's worktree

base_branch.description: Base branch to merge into (default: main). Writing to main/master is forbidden.

worktree.description: Absolute path to this task's git worktree

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 date of last metadata update

risk_level.description: R0=致命 R1=高 R2=中 R3=低
